question: Why should egg-ness not be suspected in bodies and other elements?
premises: A doubt may arise about egg-ness in bodies and other elements.
Another clarifying word addresses this doubt.
In those elements there is no placing of anything.
inference: Therefore egg-ness should not be suspected in bodies and other elements.
uncertainties: tanvakṣa is taken as body and related constituents; the exact technical scope is compressed.
plain_english: One should not suspect egg-ness in bodies and similar elements, because in them there is no placing or removing of anything.
